name: Kouno Sakura
source:
A new and famous idol she meets Ippei at the video store he works at. He asks her on a date after they discover a similar taste in movies. Although she's an idol and dating is strictly forbidden she agrees.

When Sally tells him she wants to be raped he takes her to a secluded location on their date and rapes her. He then blackmails her with video from her rape that would end her career.
